title: Reading continuous-time signal notation
description: interpret expressions like $x(t)$, $x(t+T)$, and $x(t+nT)$ in continuous time.

title: Recognizing basic sine and cosine signals
description: identify sine and cosine expressions as repeating oscillatory signals.

title: Converting period and angular frequency
description: convert between period $T$ and angular frequency $\omega$ for a sinusoid.

title: Reasoning about integer multiples
description: interpret quantities like $nT$ and $k\omega_0$ as integer multiples of base quantities.

title: Determining whether a ratio is rational
description: decide whether a ratio is rational and use that result to assess periodic behavior.

title: Using the cosine product-to-sum identity
description: rewrite a product of cosines as a sum of cosine terms.

title: Determining whether a continuous-time signal is periodic
description: check whether a signal repeats after some positive time $T$.

title: Finding the fundamental period
description: identify the smallest repeating interval of a periodic signal.

title: Finding the period of a pulse train
description: read the repeat interval of a repeating pulse waveform.

title: Reading the parameters of a sinusoid
description: extract amplitude, angular frequency, and phase from $A\sin(\omega_0 t+\phi)$.

title: Converting between period and angular frequency
description: use the relationship between $T$ and $\omega_0$ for a sinusoid.

title: Interpreting sinusoid phase
description: understand phase as setting where the sinusoid starts and how it shifts in time.

title: Identifying harmonics
description: recognize first, second, third, and higher harmonics as integer multiples of a fundamental frequency.

title: Computing harmonic angular frequencies
description: use $\omega_k = k\omega_0$ to determine a harmonic's angular frequency.

title: Recognizing harmonic components in examples
description: classify specific sinusoidal terms as the fundamental or as higher harmonics.

title: Finding a common period for two periodic signals
description: determine whether two repeating signals share a common repeat interval.

title: Testing whether a sum of periodic signals is periodic
description: use the rational-ratio condition on periods to decide whether a linear combination repeats.

title: Distinguishing linear and nonlinear signal operations
description: classify addition as a linear operation and multiplication as a nonlinear one.

title: Expanding the product of two sinusoids
description: use the product-to-sum identity to expose sum- and difference-frequency components.

title: Analyzing the equal-frequency product case
description: identify what happens when two sinusoids of the same frequency are multiplied.

title: Identifying a DC component
description: recognize a constant term as a zero-frequency component of a signal.

title: Recognizing harmonic generation from nonlinear operations
description: understand that multiplication can create new frequency components not present in the original inputs.
